//: Generates cpp-httplib.pc because lemonade-cpp's cmake uses pkg_check_modules(cpp-httplib). Cleanup runs at bundle-assembly time (after all modules build), so the .pc is visible to consumers and removed from the final image — don't move the cleanup or the post-install.
name: cpp-httplib
post-install:
printf 'Name: cpp-httplib
Description: A C++ HTTP/HTTPS server and client library
Version: 0.50.1
Requires: openssl
Cflags: -I/app/include -DCPPHTTPLIB_OPENSSL_SUPPORT
Libs: -L/app/lib -lcpp-httplib
' > /app/lib/pkgconfig/cpp-httplib.pc
